headline: China approves eight new nuclear reactors for $23.7 billion
summary: China has approved eight new nuclear reactors in four projects, with total investment above 160 billion yuan, about $23.7 billion, according to financial portal Yicai.
why: Nuclear power projects are long-cycle capital investments that benefit reactor designers, engineering contractors and equipment suppliers, and they signal China's energy-supply plans.
